full_details: It was the third week. Kemp had the remuneration and would not leave it. He weighed three farthings, bit them, and tried to buy Sam with them. Each pass ran two lines longer than the one before. He said the groundlings never paid a penny to hear what was set down. You asked, very courteously, which of the new lines were better, so that you might write them. Garnish headed a margin with a K and did not write a number under it. Burbage took Berowne's speech on love to the stable wall. Hilary term ended. The gowns will thin. In the afternoon you were in the Two Gentlemen. You did not name a part out loud. You did not go to the Rose. No sum was made of Kemp's lines.
one_sentence: You rehearsed the farthings, Garnish opened a column headed K, and you played in the gentlemen at two.
title: Rehearsed the farthings and played in the gentlemen
